svg.title: R6 · C3 regulated carrier · 18 × 24 holes — bottom worksheet
svg.text: 18 columns × 24 rows A–X · 2.54 mm pitch · nominal outline 47.78 × 63.02 mm · not a drilling template
SOLDER SIDE — flip like a book; A1 right; keep the same physical hole names
SOLDER JOINTS · one number = one conductor
Solder windows only at K10 / L16 / K18
Solder windows only at S10 / T16 / S18
Solder windows only at C10 / D16 / C18
Solder windows only at G10 / H16 / G18
Solder windows only at O10 / P16 / O18
Solder windows only at C2 / D8 / D10 / H10 / L10 / L6 / K2 / Q4 / P8 / R8 / T8 / U8 /
Solder windows only at C3 / D6 / C8 / R4
Solder windows only at E6 / N2 / Q2 / U2 / U5
Solder windows only at J6 / K6 / K3
Solder windows only at G3 / H6 / G8
Solder windows only at R6 / R7 / T6 / U7 / V5 / T2
Solder windows only at G2 / G6 / P6 / P2 / T5 / V2
WIRE / BUS: add insulated wire. Filled dots are solder joints, including
intermediate pads; other crossed pads stay unconnected. Squares mark pigtail
attachment pads; see the modules sheet. Leave component leads long until these bus
windows are soldered: retain 1.5 mm below the underside for GND/SYS/SW_SYS, or 2.9
mm for signals. Then trim excess. Add one short solid 22 AWG riser at each otherwise
empty terminal: P6, P8, R8, T6, T8, V8, V10. These reach 1.5 mm below the underside.
Lap-solder module/button cables at the pads.
432 isolated pads · square = wire attachment · use all three carrier sheets
R6 prototype / physical verification pending. Charge fully OFF. Battery negative → B−; system ground → OUT−.
